reason: A multi-platform messaging bridge that connects external chat services and HTTP clients to DSH agent sessions, with routing, session commands, webhooks, polling, and configurable access controls.

summaries.zh: 将 QQ、Telegram、Discord、飞书、企业微信等多个消息平台接入 DSH，并在统一会话中路由消息与回复。
summaries.en: Connects QQ, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, WeCom, and other messaging platforms to DSH with unified message routing and agent sessions.

capabilities: Connects DSH to multiple messaging platforms including QQ, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, and LINE
Receives inbound messages through WebSocket, webhook, polling, and HTTP endpoints
Routes messages to DSH agent sessions and sends responses back to external platforms
Supports session creation, switching, status, and help commands
Uses configurable platform tokens, webhook settings, and sender allowlists
